name: freightctl.identity

name: freightctl.exchange_source

name: freightctl.exchange_endpoints
description: List visible current endpoint heads

name: freightctl.exchange_endpoint
description: Inspect one current endpoint head

name: freightctl.prepare_exchange
description: Validate a metadata review; no offer, reservation or physical byte verification

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.offer_exchange
description: Offer one exact reviewed artifact under current source and registered participant authority. Availability only; never receiver durability or processing.

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.incoming_exchanges
description: Poll current authorized incoming views; restart each new cycle without a cursor

name: freightctl.inspect_exchange
description: Inspect an authorized incoming view; held entries are opaque

name: freightctl.retrieval_descriptor
description: Prepare a same-origin authenticated download path and exact integrity metadata. No inline bytes, retrieval grant, persistence claim or credential URL.

name: freightctl.outgoing_exchanges
description: List own historical offers and current metadata, requiring read/deliver/list

name: freightctl.exchange_receipt
description: Inspect one own original offer with current original binding/source permission; receiver outcomes remain unknown

name: freightctl.close_exchange
description: Record exact sender cancellation or recipient decline. A separate current original participant decision; never recalls prior copies.

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.prepare_onward
description: Review an owned artifact and an already approved ordered sending workflow. No run,intent,peer contact or forwarding grant.

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.start_onward
description: Atomically check the exact review and record ordinary workflow run/intents. No peer contact;required workflow/source/delivery permissions remain.

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.onward_status
description: Read current authorized workflow state and receipt hashes;no private transport references,paths,raw observations or business-acceptance inference. Requires the original exact reviewed start and its recorded receipt key;never adopts a generic unreviewed run.

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.work_onward
description: Execute at most one ordinary pending step at its registered approved peer under current policy/leases/fencing. Same work key fixes the selected intent. A lost response may hide a remote effect;inspect status and original receipt before recovery. Requires the original exact reviewed start and its recorded receipt key;never adopts a generic unreviewed run. Remote writes follow the approved adapter contract and may replace data where that contract permits;no stronger exclusivity or business guarantee is implied.

expires_at.description: Exact microsecond instant; harmless trailing fractional zeroes and equivalent offsets normalize to UTC. Admission uses database time and configured lifetime.

name: freightctl.collection_source
description: Review one exact captured actor-private collection input as a currently authorized ordinary artifact source. No collection,offer,forwarding,execution or physical-byte guarantee. Private source paths and transport references are omitted.

name: freightctl.artifact_ingress_descriptor
description: Review metadata for an ordinary root-custody upload. Returns a relative authenticated HTTPS route and exact size/SHA/request-key headers. Host sends bytes separately,outside tool/model context. No upload,receive offer,capacity reservation,approval or persistence receipt is created. Actual upload rechecks ordinary authority,policy,capacity and complete integrity.

name: freightctl.artifact_upload_start
description: Create or recover an ordinary owned resumable upload ticket for a new virtual file. Replacement revision is omitted and mode0600;no overwrite. This records metadata,not durable file acceptance. Host appends bounded bytes separately through authenticated HTTPS;not in tool context.

name: freightctl.artifact_upload_status
description: Inspect current owned upload metadata. Committed offset is a durable checkpoint,not artifact availability. Ordinary actor/root/authority/write checks apply.

name: freightctl.artifact_upload_complete
description: Complete an owned ordinary upload with a stable operation key. Ordinary service verifies every staged byte and current target authority,intake and durable publication. Original command receipt is not current availability.

name: freightctl.artifact_upload_abort
description: Abort an owned ordinary upload with a stable operation key. This changes durable ticket state;it does not delete a completed artifact or recall an exchange.

name: freightctl.validate_workflow
description: Validate an ordinary typed workflow under current workflow permission and registered connection/source checks. Returns only definition hash,counts and authorized source identity;no destination names/addresses/secret references. No approval,run,contact,reservation or durable effect. Typed schema3 records.project uses scoped owned-source processing rights;ordinary approval and release stay outside tools.

name: freightctl.propose_workflow
description: Record an ordinary versioned workflow draft proposal using a stable key and exact expected version. Requires ordinary workflow_manage;legacy workflows retain root authority. It does not approve,activate,queue or execute. Original draft receipt is not current approval state. Typed schema3 records.project uses scoped owned-source processing rights;ordinary approval and release stay outside tools.

name: freightctl.exchange_trace
description: Inspect only already authorized recorded custody/offer/closure evidence under explicit incoming-view or original-sender-receipt authority. Held incoming views remain opaque. No parent traversal,raw event payload,physical verification,receipt/grant/effect or stronger receiver outcome.

name: freightctl.copy_received_artifact
description: Create or recover a new private owned copy of exact received bytes. Requires current receive plus separate write permission;new path mode0600,no overwrite. Source bytes stay in server custody;fresh intake applies. Original-key recovery returns original acceptance,current state unchecked. No forwarding,execution or stronger receiver outcome.

virtual_path.description: Canonical new virtual path under current authenticated root;no replacement option.

name: freightctl.preview_record_projection
description: Review scoped owned-input processing without effects. Returns exact artifact/policy/mapping metadata and an opaque full-review hash;no payload,private source path or approval.

target_path.description: Optional create-only logical path. No host path, URL, overwrite or implicit publication.

reason.description: NFC-normalized, trimmed reason: 3..1024 UTF-8 bytes, at most 240 Unicode scalar values, no control characters.

name: freightctl.propose_record_projection
description: Propose the exact scoped review with a stable key. No execution or approval. Recovery preserves the original proposal without reinterpreting its source.

target_path.description: Optional create-only logical path. No host path, URL, overwrite or implicit publication.

reason.description: NFC-normalized, trimmed reason: 3..1024 UTF-8 bytes, at most 240 Unicode scalar values, no control characters.

name: freightctl.inspect_record_projection
description: Observe owned scoped processing metadata. No payload,private path,full definition,release or forwarding grant.

name: freightctl.start_record_projection
description: Start a separately approved exact scoped intent under its current revision and lease. Returns the original attempt receipt;approval stays outside this tool.

name: freightctl.work_record_projection
description: Work the exact live scoped attempt or recover its original receipt. Output stays held with fresh checks and separate release. The existing10-second MCP deadline applies;no network recipient or model runtime.

name: freightctl.processing_contracts
description: Describe an owned successfully checked input and current default or explicit producer-bound output contract. Metadata only;no contents,paths,host references,approval,run or contact. An output reference cannot grant producer authority.

name: freightctl.start_processing_workflow
description: Record one run of an already approved exact schema3 processing task. Creates only a processing intent;no delivery,release or byte-read promise. A stable key recovers original acceptance.

name: freightctl.inspect_processing_workflow
description: Observe one owned schema3 processing run. Held output,release and historical/current state stay distinct;no bytes,raw definitions or private bindings.

name: freightctl.work_processing_workflow
description: Work one pinned approved processing attempt under current ordinary authority and existing deadline. Historical attempt and current run status are separate;output remains held.

name: freightctl.refresh_processing_workflow
description: Refresh recorded processing/release outcome only. No processing,transfer,approval,release or byte retrieval.

name: freightctl.cancel_processing_workflow
description: Cancel an owned pending/expired processing run under workflow_execute. Does not steal live leases,erase a completed artifact,release or deliver bytes.

name: freightctl.list_processing_workflows
description: List the authenticated actor's latest processing task revisions and separate current approval/output-policy facts. Metadata discovery supplies no input bytes,execution readiness,approval,release or forwarding rights. Names,reasons,paths and full definitions are omitted.

name: freightctl.propose_processing_definition
description: Offer bounded definition-only rules to a named executor. Creates no workflow approval,run,file access or effect.

name: freightctl.list_processing_proposals
description: List private authored/received proposal metadata. No task contents,approval or execution.

name: freightctl.inspect_processing_proposal
description: Inspect named-party proposal metadata. Full definition requires explicit disclose_definition;receiving grants no effect.

name: freightctl.adopt_processing_proposal
description: Named executor records an owned draft under current output-policy authority. Approval,input validation and execution remain separate.

name: freightctl.close_processing_proposal
description: Reject a received pending proposal or withdraw an authored pending proposal. Cannot approve or change an adopted workflow.

name: freightctl.namespace_receipt
description: Read one original actor-private namespace commit receipt using its exact original metadata command and key. Requires current read/list/original operation grants and unchanged mount/authority meaning. Reads historical commit metadata even after source removal;opens no custody and never executes,forwards,approves or asserts current state. Original property mutation contents stay outside this metadata-only tool profile.
